# Dora

## Overview

- **Age:** Eight years old  <sub>[v2 c1 P31](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0031), [v3 c1 P31](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0031), [v3 c3 P1](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0001)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v2 c8 P5](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0005)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Dora is a fair and very pretty child with gentle, mild hazel eyes, long sleek curls that remain tidy, a straight nose, and a prim mouth. She typically looks very neat, clean, and well-behaved, often appearing as though she had just been starched and ironed.

_Sources: [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c8 P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044)_

## Personality

Dora is extraordinarily well-behaved, quiet, demure, and placid, rarely causing any trouble or getting upset. She is neat, industrious, and dutiful, faithfully carrying out her tasks and obeying directions. Though somewhat timid and easily scared by spooky tales, cows, and dark rooms, she remains calm and composed during major crises. Her consistent, predictable goodness can occasionally be perceived as somewhat monotonous.

_Sources: [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 c8 P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044), [v2 c10 P14](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0014), [v2 c10 P88](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0088), [v2 c10 P89](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0089), [v2 c16 P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), [v2 c21 P3](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0003), [v2 c21 P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 c24 P25](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0025), [v2 c26 P32](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0032), [v2 c26 P33](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0033), [v3 c3 P1](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0001), [v3 c13 P28](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0028)_

## History

Following the death of her mother, Dora and her twin brother Davy were brought to Green Gables to be taken in by Marilla Cuthbert. Unlike her mischievous brother, Dora proved to be extraordinarily quiet, polite, and helpful from the start. Shortly after arriving, she was led onto a pigpen fence by Davy, fell in, and was thoroughly soaked when he tried to wash her under the pump. On another occasion, she was locked in a toolhouse by Davy, who then falsely claimed she was lost. Despite Davy's frequent tricks and pranks, Dora remained well-behaved and dutiful, helping Marilla with chores around the house and garden. She began attending school alongside Davy under Anne Shirley's instruction. Upon the death of her uncle Richard Keith, a trust fund was established for Dora and Davy, securing their permanent home at Green Gables. During a severe hailstorm, Dora remained composed and prayed silently alongside Anne. At age eight, when Anne departed for Redmond College, Dora handled the farewell calmly and continued her studies at Sunday School and home under the care of Marilla and Mrs. Rachel Lynde.

_Sources: [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 c8 P11](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0011), [v2 c8 P12](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0012), [v2 c8 P47](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0047), [v2 c8 P49](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0049), [v2 c10 P34](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0034), [v2 c10 P36](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0036), [v2 c16 P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), [v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 c22 P22](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0022), [v2 c22 P25](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0025), [v2 c24 P25](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0025), [v2 c24 P30](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0030), [v3 c3 P1](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0001), [v3 c3 P2](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0002), [v3 c13 P0](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0000)_

## Background by volume

- Orphaned as a twin after her father died during her infancy and her sick mother died years later  <sub>[v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c8 P7](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0007)</sub>
- Taken in by Marilla Cuthbert and Anne Shirley at Green Gables  <sub>[v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 c8 P11](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0011)</sub>
- Left a share of a two-thousand-dollar trust fund by her uncle Richard Keith  <sub>[v2 c22 P22](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0022)</sub>
